test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ten years ago, Krishna was one-third as old as he will be 20 years from now. Krishna’s present age (in years) is ______.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the present age of Krishna is 'x' years.

Ten years ago his age = (x - 10) years

According to question

⇒ (x - 10) = (1/3)(x + 20)

⇒ 3x - 30 = x + 20

⇒ x = 25

Krishna’s present age = 25 years.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
